description:
Log in to ArkCase and create a new task within an existing complaint case.

Credentials:
- Username: arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com
- Password: ArkCase1234!

ArkCase URL: https://localhost:9443/arkcase/

After logging in, locate the complaint case titled 'Henderson v. DOJ – FOIA #2025-0472' (check the Complaints module or use search). Open the case, navigate to its Tasks tab, and create a new task with EXACTLY these details:

- Subject/Title: Review Response Package for Completeness
- Priority: High
- Start Date: 06/15/2025
- Due Date: 08/01/2025
- Percent Complete: 0
- Details/Notes: Review all documents in the FOIA response package to ensure completeness and compliance with agency disclosure guidelines before final release to the requester. Flag any Exemption 5 deliberative process claims for attorney review.
- Assignee: arkcase-admin (assign to yourself)

Save the task. It should appear in the case's task list when complete.
